research: Biedermann, 1751, Tabula CCCCXI A (data/books/bidermann_1751.json), states that Georg Eyrich von Erthal married Regina Kunegunda von Rosenberg in 1586 and that she died on 31 August 1620. If both participated while married and alive, the partition agreement may date from 1586–1620. The 21 July 1648 fief confirmation (Thüringisches Staatsarchiv Gotha, Hennebergica Gotha (Urkunden), 4-10-0030, no. 101, https://www.archive-in-thueringen.de/de/findbuch/view/searchterm/grabfeld/submit/submit/page/4/bestand/24212/systematik/264814/archivgut/5598135/searchall/grabfeld) records a Gochsheim property purchase in 1602. If the partition covered that same property, 1602 would narrow the earliest possible date. The catalogue abstract does not identify the individual Gochsheim properties or date the additional inheritance renunciations. Two related holdings at Staatsarchiv Kitzingen are Familienakten 18/a, a surviving contents list with some family contracts (1555–1622), and Familienakten 19, a copy of family contracts and daughters’ renunciations (1552–1664). The catalogue descriptions do not identify this partition by name.

entries.source: StAWü, Adelsarchiv (der Freiherren) von Erthal Familienakten 17
entries.german:
Teilungsvertrag des Georg Eyrich von Erthal uns seiner Ehefrau Regina Kunegunda, geb. von Rosenberg über die Güter zu Elfershausen, Gochsheim, Kissingen und Leutzendorf unter seine 3 Söhne Hans Christoph, Albrecht Dietrich und Georg Wilhelm von Erthal.

Enthält-/Darin-Vermerke: Enthält auch: Erbverzicht der Cristina Susanna von Erthal (verehelichte Truchseßin von Wetzhausen, Clara Eva von Erthal (verehelichte Mörstein zu Biebersfeldt), Sophia Juliana von Erthal (verehelichte von Schrottenberg), Anna Barbara von Erthal (verehelicht mit Johann Gottfried Freiherr von Knörringen).
entries.english:
Partition agreement of Georg Eyrich von Erthal and his wife Regina Kunegunda, née von Rosenberg, concerning the estates at Elfershausen, Gochsheim, Kissingen and Leutzendorf, among his three sons Hans Christoph, Albrecht Dietrich and Georg Wilhelm von Erthal.

Contains/includes: also contains: renunciation of inheritance by Cristina Susanna von Erthal (married to a Truchseßin von Wetzhausen), Clara Eva von Erthal (married to Mörstein zu Biebersfeldt), Sophia Juliana von Erthal (married to von Schrottenberg), and Anna Barbara von Erthal (married to Johann Gottfried Freiherr von Knörringen).
